description: Fixture_Corpus manifest (Requirements 19.1, 19.2, 19.9). One entry per Contract_Shape_Taxonomy shape. 'expected_outcome' is a member of spec_pipeline.outcomes.Outcome and reflects the terminal outcome for THIS environment, where slither, solc, and certoraRun are absent (network disabled, tools removed from PATH). Outcomes marked tool-dependent in 'notes' would change if the missing external tool were installed.

single_file.notes: One first-party contract in one file. Stage 1-4 run from the LLM_Cache; Stage 5 needs certoraRun/solc which are absent, so the run terminates with tool_unavailable. Tool-dependent: with the prover installed this could reach a verification verdict.

multi_contract.notes: Multiple first-party contracts in one project. Terminates at Stage 5 with tool_unavailable because certoraRun/solc are absent. Tool-dependent.

inheritance_depth.notes: Inheritance chain of depth three or more. Terminates at Stage 5 with tool_unavailable because certoraRun/solc are absent. Tool-dependent.

library_dependent.notes: First-party contract depending on a library. Terminates at Stage 5 with tool_unavailable because certoraRun/solc are absent. Tool-dependent.

struct_enum_signature.notes: Struct/enum type in an external function signature. Terminates at Stage 5 with tool_unavailable because certoraRun/solc are absent. Tool-dependent.

upgradeable_proxy.notes: Upgradeable proxy with an initializer instead of a constructor. Terminates at Stage 5 with tool_unavailable because certoraRun/solc are absent. Tool-dependent.

foundry_layout.notes: Foundry build layout (foundry.toml, remappings.txt, src/, lib/). Terminates at Stage 5 with tool_unavailable because certoraRun/solc are absent. Tool-dependent.

hardhat_layout.notes: Hardhat build layout (hardhat.config.js, package.json, contracts/). Terminates at Stage 5 with tool_unavailable because certoraRun/solc are absent. Tool-dependent.

npm_dependency.notes: npm dependency layout with node_modules/*/*.sol imports. Terminates at Stage 5 with tool_unavailable because certoraRun/solc are absent. Tool-dependent.

mixed_pragmas.notes: Two first-party files declaring disjoint solc pragmas (0.6.12 and 0.8.19). The Project_Resolver finds no common version and reports unsupported_pragma_set before any prover invocation. Not tool-dependent: the disjoint pragma set is detected from the sources alone.

interface_only.notes: File declaring only interfaces (no concrete contract). The Extractor finds zero first-party contracts, so the run short-circuits with no_first_party_contracts before any LLM call. Not tool-dependent.

abstract_contract.notes: File declaring only an abstract contract (no deployable first-party contract). The Extractor finds zero first-party contracts, so the run short-circuits with no_first_party_contracts. Not tool-dependent.
